description: This file defines a generic command class 'ServerCommand<T>' for configuring and running server instances in a distributed system, along with a static helper class 'Server' to create such commands. It utilizes System.CommandLine for command-line parsing and integrates with a silo configurator and runner.

classes.name: ServerCommand<T>
classes.description: A command class that sets up server options and execution handler for a distributed server node.

classes.name: Server
classes.description: A static helper class providing a method to create server commands.

methods.name: CreateCommand
methods.description: Creates a new instance of ServerCommand<T> with the provided silo configurator.
